nodes.title: Read me
widgets_values:
RIGGED FBX + CLIP -> ANIMATED FBX

UniRig ships five Mixamo clips and none of them are game cycles.  For
idle/walk/attack, drop clips into input/animation_templates/mixamo/ or
use mesh2motion's 176 CC0 clips.  scripts/list_animations.py prints
both libraries.

---

Apply a Mixamo animation to a rigged FBX from
mesh_rig_unirig.json. animation_file is a combo built from
input/animation_templates/mixamo/, which ships Breakdance,
Capoeira, Dying, Hip_Hop_Dancing and Mma_Kick — drop more .fbx
there and they appear in the list.
